thinking_choices.none: run an exact supplied command and report its output, copy exact text, or list files; no interpretation
thinking_choices.low: narrow fact lookup in named files, including finding definitions, counting matches, or answering a specific question with line references
thinking_choices.high: survey several files when the answer needs synthesis, or make a small doc patch
thinking_choices.max: tracing a cause or cross-checking conflicting claims that need careful reasoning
